heading: Rule 8 — the fundamental constraints
text:
### Rule 8 — the fundamental constraints [LCAP.3.8]

Every program's resolved settings, and every dialect's settings, must
satisfy each of these. They are fixed rules of what the engine supports:
neither an author nor a dialect overrides them, and the compiler switches
nothing on or off to satisfy them ([LDIA.3.5.1]).

| If this is `true` | this must be `true` |
|---|---|
| `storage_hydrate_facts` | `call` |
| `storage_hydrate_samples` | `call` |
| `nocooldown` | `call` |
| `persist_on_series` | `series` |

The storage capabilities dispatch through `call`; `nocooldown` modifies a
`call`; `persist_on_series` modifies a `series` declaration. The constraint
between the two deferred strategies is [LCAP.3.7].
